notes.title: 1.2 in Sight — Take a Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
[p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]It’s been two months since our last update, and we’ve really missed sharing news with you. But let’s get straight to what matters: [b]Update 1.2 “Living Word”[/b] is coming together, and we want to give you a glimpse of what’s on the way.[/p][p][b]🎮 Update 1.2 “Living Word”[/b][/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/ebb386f32b0c731ef61b84940777f275509ac1f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The name of this update reflects our goal: to create a space where every player can [b]encounter the life that already exists in the Word[/b], exploring biblical passages and discovering both familiar and new insights. Every mode and feature is designed so that fun and learning go hand in hand, while keeping the essence of the Scriptures — without adding or removing anything.[/p][p]Among the new features are five different game modes, including the Letters mode, which allows you to form words and phrases from biblical passages, with a variety of themes and packs that refresh the experience with each game. Additionally, we have a level system, meaningful unlocks and rewards, updated visuals, and the Korean language, expanding the ways you can explore and enjoy the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/e69bebb9228db0313284c57acf031742dc6b68ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The images we’ve shared show just a small part of what’s ready, but the full experience happens when you play, explore each detail, and feel that every session is also an opportunity to learn something new.[/p][p]We want to sincerely thank everyone who continues to support us, leave reviews, and share your experiences. Every comment inspires us to deepen questions, explore passages, and make [i]Bible Trivia[/i] even more special. The Word is alive — and together, we continue discovering![/p]

notes.title: Upcoming Update 1.2: Living Word
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/30276b0b99a2a1d569282493f71fb310a068d4b5.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone,
We’re excited to give you a preview of what’s coming in the next major update to [i]Bible Trivia[/i] — and it’s packed with meaningful content![/p][p]Titled [b]Living Word[/b], this new update marks a fresh chapter in the development of the game. Many of the features have been requested by you, our community, and others are designed to take the experience further — more rewarding, more varied, and more interactive.[/p][h3]New Languages[/h3][p]We’re expanding access to the Word. The game will officially support [b]Japanese[/b] and [b]Korean[/b] in the base version, including translated interface and content.[/p][h3]DLC Wisdom Improvements[/h3][p]For those who own the [i]Wisdom[/i] DLC, two much-requested features are being added:[/p][list][*][p]You’ll now be able to [b]copy Bible verses[/b] displayed in-game to share or save.[/p][/*][*][p]You’ll also be able to [b]pin your favorite verses[/b], making it easier to revisit meaningful passages.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Daily Reward System[/h3][p]We’re introducing a login reward system. By simply entering the game each day, you can earn gifts — from coins and customization items to new characters.[/p][h3]Missions and Challenges[/h3][p]The update will introduce thematic missions and special challenges, rewarding you with [b]new playable characters[/b] with their own dialogue. Completing objectives will be part of your spiritual and gameplay journey.[/p][h3]XP Bar and Level System[/h3][p]After finishing a round, you’ll now see a new experience bar. When you level up, you’ll unlock visual effects and special rewards — making your progress feel even more satisfying.[/p][h3]Consecutive Answer Streak Animations[/h3][p]Answering multiple questions correctly in a row will now trigger visual effects to reward your momentum and accuracy.[/p][h3]New Game Modes[/h3][p]The update will add a variety of new modes, each offering a unique challenge. Some modes will require special items to unlock — earned by completing a set number of books.[/p][p]Game modes include:[/p][list][*][p][b]Classic[/b]: the familiar mode with themed questions per book[/p][/*][*][p][b]Survival[/b]: one wrong answer ends the session[/p][/*][*][p][b]PvP Duel (vs. AI)[/b]: quick 1v1-style question battles[/p][/*][*][p][b]Speed Mode[/b]: 10 questions in just 30 seconds[/p][/*][*][p][b]Word Mode[/b]: form biblical words from scattered letters[/p][/*][*][p][b]Timer Mode[/b]: answer as many as possible in 60 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3]Avatar Customization[/h3][p]You’ll be able to unlock and equip [b]hats, hairstyles, faces, outfits[/b], and more to personalize your in-game character. These items can be earned through progress and special rewards.[/p][h3]Daily and Weekly Challenges[/h3][p]There will be rotating challenges with new objectives released daily and weekly. These are designed to encourage short, fun, consistent sessions with exclusive rewards.[/p][h3]Bible Facts and Context as Level-Up Rewards[/h3][p]When you level up, you’ll unlock [b]Bible fact cards[/b] — real and inspiring information about Scripture, presented in a sliding card format.[/p][p]Example:
“Did you know the longest book in the Bible is Psalms?”[/p][hr][/hr][p]We’re working hard to make this update one of the most rewarding yet. [i]Living Word[/i] is more than a content pack — it’s a step forward in our mission to combine learning, enjoyment, and spiritual growth through gameplay.[/p][p]Stay tuned to the Steam News section for updates on the release date.[/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey.
The Word remains alive — and now more interactive than ever.[/p][p]— Bible Trivia Team[/p]

notes.title: Bible Trivia: Wisdom DLC Release
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/d9797cceee753319b5d197897b562138748cb18f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’ve got some amazing news to share — the brand new [b]Wisdom DLC[/b] is out now, and it brings something that truly changes everything about the Bible Trivia experience.[/p][p]📖 [b]The full Bible is now inside the game![/b][/p][p]That’s right. You can now read, search, and explore the entire Bible without ever leaving the game.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✨ What’s included in the [i]Wisdom[/i] DLC?[/h3][p]🔹 [b]Complete Bible access in multiple languages[/b]
Every supported language in the game now features [b]at least 4 of the most widely-used Bible translations[/b] — carefully selected to match what players actually read and study in their faith traditions.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Quick verse search[/b]
Look up any passage you want — just type a reference like “Psalm 23” or “John 3:16” and go straight to the verse.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Verse-by-verse note system[/b]
Write your own study notes, insights, or reminders directly on any verse you read. Your personal reflections are saved and easy to revisit.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Offline access[/b]
All features work without an internet connection — perfect for personal devotion, quiet study, or travel.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Supports Windows and macOS[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h3]🙌 Why is this DLC so special?[/h3][p]Because now, [i]Bible Trivia[/i] is more than just a fun quiz —
With [i]Wisdom[/i], it becomes a full Bible study companion.[/p][p]Whether you’re reviewing a question, diving deeper into Scripture, or simply taking a moment to reflect, this DLC puts the Bible directly into your hands — inside the game.[/p][p]You can now explore the Word, take notes, and study your favorite passages anytime.[/p][hr][/hr][p]🎁 [b]Launch price: just $1.99 USD[/b]
Grab it now on Steam and enjoy a special discount for a limited time![/p][p]👉 [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820730/Bible_Trivia__Wisdom/"]Click here to get the Wisdom DLC[/url][/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you so much to our amazing community — this DLC was created based on your feedback and support. We hope it brings inspiration and meaning to your time with [i]Bible Trivia[/i].[/p]

notes.title: SMALL UPDATE. PATCH NOTES V.1.1.052
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/6198f4ab116bfc369dae6fac8911e952e7111577.png[/img]

[h1]Update Available![/h1]

[h1]Großartige Neuigkeiten! (Yes, that’s German!)[/h1]

[list]
[*]We’ve officially added support for the [b]German[/b] language! A special thanks to the linguistic explorer [b]CroMagnonBC[/b], whose request echoed through time and reached the development altar. Danke schön!
[*]The game is now also available for [b]Mac[/b]! That’s right, Apple archaeologists, it’s your turn to dig with style.
[*]Minor interface changes — nothing drastic, but that one button that always looked off? It’s now 27% more charming.
[*]Fixed typos and questions that were more tangled than an ancient scroll.
[*]Overall improvements in languages: we cleaned, polished, and even gave the dialogues a nice shine.
[*]Reduced the game's weight a bit — now it carries fewer digital sins and runs smoother.
[/list]

[h2]A Little Note on German...[/h2]
Just a heads-up: [b]I'm not German[/b] — not even a distant relative of Martin Luther! So if you spot any mistakes in the translation, please be patient and forgiving. 😅
That said, I have all the translation files neatly packed and ready. So if any brave German-speaking hero (or speaker of any other language!) wants to help improve the translations, [b]I welcome your holy assistance[/b]! Drop me a message and join the mission. 🙌

[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
A heartfelt thank-you to [b]CroMagnonBC[/b] and all the players who sent suggestions, reported bugs, and spread good vibes. You are the scribes of our progress!

[h2]What’s coming next?[/h2]
[expand type=details expanded=false]Get your sandals and turbans ready, because the next chapters are diving even deeper into the biblical universe! We’re working on new historical eras, mysterious characters, and dialogues that will challenge both your mind and your faith. Hold onto your scrolls — exciting things are coming![/expand]

May the game now be even more fun, lightweight, and accessible — and may you find the right answer before the next plague hits.
[b]Get ready for excavations![/b] 🏺

notes.title: New Content Available! Legacy
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/dd9eb277cdd7cfa9ae230c9b4d810cb87dc9f9d5.jpg[/img]

[b][u]TALK TO THE PATRIARCHS (AND DISCOVER THEIR STORIES)![/u][/b]
The [b]DLC Legacy[/b] for [i]Bible Trivia[/i] has just arrived!

Have you ever imagined having a chat with the most iconic figures of the Old Testament? Now you can, with secrets revealed and surprising moments!

[h2]Explore History with a Personal Touch:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Abraham[/b] – The father of faith who nearly sacrificed his son. But what was really going through his mind at that moment?
[*][b]Sarah[/b] – She laughed when she heard she would have a child in her old age... and now she shares her journey of hope and doubts!
[*][b]Jacob[/b] – The man who deceived and was deceived. How did he transform from a trickster into a patriarch?
[*][b]Joseph[/b] – From the pit to the palace! He forgave his brothers, but did he truly let go of all resentment?
[*][b]Esau[/b] – He sold his birthright for a bowl of lentils... and now he has a lot to say about it!
[*][b]Melchizedek[/b] – The mysterious king of Salem who appeared, blessed Abraham, and vanished. Who was he really?
[/list]

[h2]Why You Should Play:[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Engaging dialogues[/b] that bring new perspectives on biblical characters!
[*][b]Emotional moments[/b] and intriguing decisions to explore!
[*][b]Fun learning[/b] with an innovative and interactive approach!
[/list]

[b]Step into history, uncover the untold stories of the patriarchs, and see the Bible like never before![/b]

notes.title: New Content Available! Reign
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44763419/adef947f22706ce335ab69036b3df9807a40f59f.jpg[/img]

[b][u]TIME TO UNCOVER ROYAL SECRETS (AND HAVE A GOOD LAUGH)![/u][/b]  
The [b]Reign DLC[/b] for [i]Bible Trivia[/i] has just arrived!  

Ever wondered what it would be like to chat with the first kings of Israel? Now you can—while having a blast!  

[h2]Step into History with a Twist:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]David[/b] – The giant-slayer turned king... but was he always that heroic? Maybe he had some embarrassing stories too!  
[*][b]Saul[/b] – First king of Israel and master of impulsive decisions. Who knew royal drama could be so relatable?  
[*][b]Solomon[/b] – Renowned for his wisdom, but even he had his doubts. Ready to challenge the wisest man in history?  
[*][b]Goliath[/b] – Everyone knows his defeat, but have you ever heard his version of the story? Maybe he just woke up on the wrong side of the bed...  
[/list]  

[h2]Why You'll Love It:[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Hilarious dialogues[/b] that bring history to life in a fun and unexpected way!  
[*][b]Unique challenges[/b] inspired by legendary choices and epic battles!  
[*][b]A refreshing take on learning[/b] that mixes knowledge with humor!  
[/list]  

[b]Dive into history, laugh along the way, and discover the untold stories of the first kings![/b]

notes.content:

-Informational texts have been added to improve interaction within the game. Now, to change your avatar, simply click on the “Change” option, and for the dialogue mode, the text “Chat” has been added.

-Additional instructions in the dialogue section: when selecting a conversation, a message will appear asking you to choose which biblical character you want to interact with.

notes.title: Content Update 1.1 - Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Ci-3JovCytk;full][/previewyoutube]

We are thrilled to announce a monumental update for our biblical game, bringing a series of new features and improvements that will further enrich your experience. Check out what's coming:

[list]
[*]🛠Completely Revamped HUD: Numerous improvements for more intuitive navigation and an enhanced visual experience.
[*]🎁Updated Prize Chest: Now with amazing new rewards for you to discover.
[*]🎵 New Music: Turn up the volume and enjoy fresh soundtracks as you play.
[*]🔤 Spelling and Grammar Corrections: Meticulous adjustments to the text, now more accurate in all languages.
[*]🌍 New Languages Added: Play in Russian and Spanish, expanding our global community.
[*]🔊 Sound Adjustment System: Customize the game’s audio to your liking, ensuring even greater immersion.
[*]🧑‍🎨 Choose Your Avatar: Select an avatar that matches your style and personality.
[*]📜 Talk to Moses!: Yes, you can now have conversations with Moses from the Bible! Soon, you'll also be able to chat with other great figures like David, Abraham, Joseph, Paul, and even Jesus.
[*] 🏞 New Background Scenarios: Immerse yourself in elegant and thematic landscapes.
[*]❓New Questions and Themes: Dive into new challenges and explore fresh topics.
[/list]

And this is just the beginning... There's so much more waiting for you in this epic update! Don't waste any time—come and explore everything we've carefully prepared for you.

Well, as always, thank you for playing Bible Trivia!
